title: Tags input field
description: Words kept as tags — labels, stamps, keywords —, each once, in the order they were added. The field's value is the list of words (`tags`), not a text: `value` stays unset. Sent as one text, the words joined by `separator`. Words may be offered while typing: the field's own (`suggestions`) and those a source answers for what is typed (`suggestionsUrl`, asked with `q`, answering words or `{ value, label }`). Every tag of the field is drawn the same way: a tone (a state's or a category's) and a glyph.
